projects.name: Photo Memoria
projects.description: A web-based photo booth application that guides users through a seamless flow — from capturing shots to selecting backgrounds and filters. Built with Vue and Quasar, the app delivers a fun and polished experience with a downloadable photo strip output.

projects.name: Potty Studio
projects.description: A playful branding project for Potty Studio by Miss Dani, a pottery and clay workshop centered on creative freedom and fun. The identity spans a whimsical logo, signage, and packaging collateral — all designed to reflect the studio's warm, approachable, and hands-on personality.

projects.name: space
projects.description: A high-fidelity mobile app concept designed for discovering and booking premium rental properties. The design features a filterable property listing view and a detailed property profile, showcasing key information such as floor area, amenities, and location at a glance. Crafted entirely in Figma with attention to component consistency, spacing, and mobile-first layout principles.

projects.name: Sweet Clouds
projects.tagline: Scoops, waffles, and a whole lot of sweet.
projects.description: A full branding and print design project for Sweet Clouds, a dessert brand specializing in ice cream and waffles. The deliverables include a hanging menu, chest fridge wrap, and pint packaging — all tied together with a soft pink palette, playful cloud motifs, and a warm, inviting aesthetic.

projects.name: spero
projects.tagline: Giving hope, one child at a time.
projects.description: A clean and friendly mobile app UI concept featuring a welcome screen, log-in, and sign-up flow designed with a warm blue palette. The layout prioritizes simplicity and ease of use, with role-based registration and an approachable visual style suited for a family or child-oriented platform.

projects.name: AMIGO
projects.description: A bold branding project for Amigo, a Mexican birria taco food truck concept built around a vibrant red, black, and gold identity. The design covers full truck livery, menu boards, and promotional signage — capturing the brand's lively, street-food energy with a distinctly Mexican flair.
